newsitem.title: RUSSIA: One dies in fire on Russian nuclear icebreaker.
newsitem.headline: One dies in fire on Russian nuclear icebreaker.

text.p: One crew member was killed when a fire broke out aboard a nuclear-powered Russian icebreaker early on Monday, Russian news agencies said.
The shipping company said the nuclear reactor powering the ship was not affected by the fire, which broke out in a cabin, and there was no leak of radiation, Itar-Tass news agency said.
The crew extinguished the blaze within 30 minutes, but could not save the life of the mechanic whose cabin caught fire.
The ship, the Yamal, was operating out of the port of Murmansk, near Russia's border with Norway and well to the north of the Arctic Circle.
